items.title: Mr. and Mrs. A.C. Synigal and B. Bozant Interview, 1962-05-17
items.q: The interviewer mentions 'A fellow used to be a professional at an accordion. His name was Lily.' The interviewee does not respond with any personal connection or memory of this individual.

ctx.x: What about those accordion players and guitar players? Do you remember any of their names?
Yeah, I know one player's name. A fellow used to be a professional at an accordion. His name was Lily.

Lily. His name was Lily. Do you remember bands from neighboring cities like, say, E. Van Thomas from Outta Crowley? Did you ever hear him? No, I don't remember. I just wondered if you'd ever heard of him. Mostly Bunk you remember.
